test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**quest**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Quest** means **to search **or **pursuit**

 
 
• Example,*** fi***nding another habitable planet is a never-ending quest. 
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, **The quest to discover the real rural India still continues in great earnest.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Resistance** means** to oppose.**

 
 
• Example, ***the robber was showing resistance to arrest after being caught.***
 
 
 
• **Flight** means **to fly**.
 
 
• Example, ***the bird took flight and disappeared in the vast blue sky.***
 
 
 
• **Discovery** means** to find or uncover something**.
 
 
• Example,*** H. Carter unearthed one of the greatest tombs ever discovered.***
